subject: C2a3 initial library semantic source audit r1, uncompiled

findings.title: Raw candidate slots bypass their mandatory fee and create an unowned invariant route
findings.concreteFailure: A caller can allocate a correct-length Vec<Option<ClosureCandidate>> containing only None without calling prepare_slots, then pass its mutable slice to AdmittedSet::admit. Admission can succeed while only the result-array half is charged, omitting the candidate-array R(n*S_c) plus movement fee. Wrong-length or pre-populated raw slots instead become Fault::Slots and flatten to the same unit Invariant as CollectorFault, leaving later carrier wiring unable to avoid misrecording the slot defect under the accepted collector-only operational key.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use an opaque non-constructible prepared-slot carrier whose sole constructor performs the exact candidate-array charge and allocation and whose storage cannot be externally resized or pre-populated; have admit consume or uniquely borrow that carrier while preserving the separate result-array charge. Remove the public-reachable Slots route by construction, or obtain a reviewed plan and owner successor selecting distinct slot-invariant semantics and a bounded key. Add source controls for fee non-bypass and invariant-route separation.

evidenceLimitations: Early semantic source audit only; no script, import, compiler, build, test, formatter, linter, native code, or fixture was executed.
Source arithmetic does not establish ABI or layout, allocation behavior, complete source-operation coverage, safe compilation, or runtime charge conformance.
All omitted controls and later source, native, unit, inventory, production-composition, census, fit, integration, and qualification gates listed in SCOPE.md remain open.
